summary: Kept agentd ecosystem visibility read-only while adding operator projection and aom activation preview output that distinguishes staged, active and activation-prepared states.
acceptance_evidence: OperatorProjection exposes ecosystem registry status, lifecycle commands, staging root, activation authority and blocked prerequisites as read-only data.
Projection reports activation_status=gated, staged_artifacts_active=false and staged_and_active_separated=true.
aom activate projects AgentCore plan_spec and activation_plan_preview while keeping active=false and activation_prepared=false.
aom stage remains inert and does not create an active directory.
Projection and support bundle tests verify redaction behavior and avoid leaking raw secret-like content.

commands.summary: Workspace tests passed with 58 agentd tests.

blocked_shortcuts: agentd does not own resolver business logic.
agentd does not execute activation side effects.
Projection does not mark staged artifacts as active.
Projection does not expose raw manifest secret-like fields.
Activation preview does not imply activation_prepared or active state.
promotion_impact: Operators now get a read-only view of ecosystem activation readiness while runtime-mediated activation remains owned by AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine.
